title: Proactive Vehicle Re-routing Strategies for Congestion Avoidance
authors: Juan (Susan) Pan, Mohammad A. Khan, Iulian Sandu Popa, Karine Zeitouni, Cristian Borcea
implementation_scope: Greenshields current costs and DSP/RkSP/EBkSP selector adaptations; not full published rerouting system
differences: Frozen six free-flow paths, then up to three current-cost paths
Departure-only intervention; no periodic upstream urgency selection
Mixed assumed vehicles and uncalibrated Bengaluru networks
